meta.name: What We Do in the Shadows
meta.description:
A documentary-style look into the daily (or rather, nightly) lives of a group of vampires in Staten Island who have “lived” together for hundreds and hundreds of years.

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 10/10 | S4 10/10 | S5 5/10 (missing E6-10) | S6 not on server

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The vampires try to plan a lavish bloodfeast in honor of a visit by their ancient master from the Old Country.

videos.title: City Council
videos.overview: The vampires get embroiled in local Staten Island politics as their first step to world domination.

videos.title: Werewolf Feud
videos.overview: The fragile truce between the vampires and Staten Island’s werewolves is tested, and Colin Robinson finds romance with a new co-worker.

videos.title: Manhattan Night Club
videos.overview: The vampires venture into Manhattan, to make an alliance with an old friend who is now the king of the Manhattan vampires.

videos.title: Animal Control
videos.overview: Lazslo, in bat form, is captured by Staten Island Animal Control and must be rescued, while Nadja can no longer resist reconnecting with her reincarnated lover Gregor.

videos.title: Baron's Night Out
videos.overview: The Baron awakens from his slumber and demands to experience the wonders of the New World in a night out on the town.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: The vampires must defend themselves as an international vampire tribunal gathers to judge them for their transgressions.

videos.title: Citizenship
videos.overview: Nadja trains Jenna on how to take her first victim, and Nandor applies for American citizenship.

videos.title: The Orgy
videos.overview: Tensions run high as the vampires prepare to host the Biannual Vampire Orgy.

videos.title: Ancestry
videos.overview: Nandor visits one of his living descendants, and a lover from Nadja's past re-emerges.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: Nadja and Laszlo's new familiar poses problems for an increasingly anxious Guillermo, and the vampires enlist the services of a local necromancer.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: The vampires hold a séance to deal with a ghost infestation, which leads to a larger ghost infestation.

videos.title: Brain Scramblies
videos.overview: The vampires attend their first human Super Bowl party, while Guillermo’s search for virgins uncovers a deadly threat.

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: While the vampires fear they've been electronically cursed, Guillermo tries to thwart a deadly threat to his masters.

videos.title: Colin's Promotion
videos.overview: Colin Robinson gets promoted at work, and his new power threatens the balance of power in the vampire house.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: After a vengeful enemy from the past appears without warning, Laszlo flees his home and goes into hiding to avoid certain death.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: The vampires offer shelter to an old nemesis who’s down on his luck.

videos.title: Collaboration
videos.overview: Nandor's old familiar from the 1970s returns to Staten Island, Guillermo leaves to serve a new master, and Nadja and Lazslo revive their musical act.

videos.title: Witches
videos.overview: When Nandor and Laszlo are abducted by a coven of witches, the others must venture to Brooklyn to rescue them.

videos.title: Nouveau Théâtre des Vampires
videos.overview: As they prepare to attend the most exclusive event on the vampiric social calendar, the vampires try to survive without Guillermo.

videos.title: The Prisoner
videos.overview: Guillermo's fate hangs in the balance as the vampires receive a promotion.

videos.title: The Cloak of Duplication
videos.overview: A forbidden artifact is used to help Nandor court a health club employee.

videos.title: Gail
videos.overview: An old flame returns, and an ancient vehicle is resurrected.

videos.title: The Casino
videos.overview: The vampires embark on a road trip from which they may never return.

videos.title: The Chamber of Judgement
videos.overview: Justice is served, both vampirically and also in small claims court.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: An ancient beast escapes and threatens the existence of all vampires everywhere.

videos.title: The Siren
videos.overview: Two travelers are shipwrecked and a doll runs away from home.

videos.title: The Wellness Center
videos.overview: Nandor is persuaded to reject vampirism and pursue a healthier lifestyle.

videos.title: A Farewell
videos.overview: Colin has a birthday and a vampire says goodbye.

videos.title: The Portrait
videos.overview: The housemates grieve the loss of one of their own.

videos.title: Reunited
videos.overview: The vampires return from their world travels to find their mansion on the verge of collapse, and a freakish new creature in the house.

videos.title: The Lamp
videos.overview: Nandor's search for love is finally successful, and Nadja realizes her lifelong ambition of opening a vampire nightclub.

videos.title: The Grand Opening
videos.overview: The opening night of Nadja's vampire nightclub is threatened when the big musical guest cancels.

videos.title: The Night Market
videos.overview: The vampires take a trip to the secret Night Market, where all the supernatural creatures gather to barter and haggle.

videos.title: Private School
videos.overview: The vampires endure the private school admissions interview process.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Guillermo loses his mind trying to help Nandor plan the perfect vampire wedding.

videos.title: Pine Barrens
videos.overview: Nandor and Laszlo air out their differences on a hunting trip at an isolated cabin, Nadja has a girls' night, and Guillermo reconnects with his family for the first time in twelve years.

videos.title: Go Flip Yourself
videos.overview: The mansion gets a makeover.

videos.title: Freddie
videos.overview: Guillermo has a visitor from overseas.

videos.title: Sunrise, Sunset
videos.overview: Baby Colin reaches that awkward age.

videos.title: The Mall
videos.overview: The vampires discover the mall.

videos.title: A Night Out with the Guys
videos.overview: Nandor and Laszlo have a night out with Sean and his friends. Nadja discovers the source of her bad luck.

videos.title: Pride Parade
videos.overview: The vampires help Sean host a Pride parade. Nadja helps her doll achieve a long-held dream.

videos.title: The Campaign
videos.overview: Colin runs for office, Nandor makes a new friend and Nadja reconnects with her roots.

videos.title: Local News
videos.overview: Coverage of a local water main break brings unwanted attention to the vampires.

meta.slogan: Don't ask what they do outside the shadows.
